name: How to lose one's virginity
source:
A computer game enthusiast, he neglected his studies and appearance. What must one go through in order to find self-motivation and a thirst for action? After all, even three sexy beauties living with him in one house were not a sufficient reason.

The hero has to walk on the edge to understand what he's doing wrong. The problem is recognized, but what's next? How to change one's character? Maybe one needs to break themselves? A random idea about a specific part-time job changes everything.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2578880/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
作为一名电脑游戏爱好者，他忽视了自己的学业和外表。为了找到自我激励和对行动的渴望，一个人必须经历什么？毕竟，就算是三个性感美女与他同住一所，也不足以成为理由。

英雄必须走在边缘才能明白自己做错了什么。问题已经认识到了，但是接下来怎么办？如何改变一个人的性格？也许一个人需要打破自己？关于某个特定兼职工作的随机想法会改变一切。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2578880/]Steam[/url]]
